Детектор Apple CoreML для ViON. Распозна: Apple CoreML detection for ViON. Object detection, face detection and recognition, license plate reading (OCR) and CLIP semantic search on Apple hardware.
Модель CLIP для эмбеддингов семантическо: CLIP model for the semantic search, shared by all cameras. After you change it, the recordings have to be reindexed.
Модель, преобразующая лицо в вектор, общ: Model used to recognize faces, shared by all cameras. After you change it, the saved faces are recalculated.
Размещение вычислений CoreML. ALL исполь: Where CoreML runs the models. ALL uses CPU + GPU + Neural Engine; the other options use only some of them.
Вычислительные блоки, на которых сейчас: Compute units the loaded models are currently running on.
Сбросить все настройки плагина к значени: Reset all plugin settings to their defaults
Очистить локальный кэш моделей и заново: Delete the downloaded models and download the current ones again.
